data.name: Trideep Chouhan
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Trideep Chouhan has made a big mark in cricket. With 40 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70, with an average of 21.97 and a quick strike rate of 135.33. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 39 sixes and 57 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 38.3 overs, taking 17 wickets at an economy rate of 8.78. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
